title: HED-Derived iPSCs Reveal Neurofunctional Defects in Ectodermal Dysplasia
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Ectodermal dysplasia (ED) is characterized by sparse hair, reduced sweat gland secretion, and congenital absence of teeth. While genes such asEDAandEDARhave been identified as causative factors of ED, the underlying mechanisms remain unknown, and ...
